Info

Factory module for instantiating PlanSelectionCoordinator instances.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.plan.selection.plan_selection_coordinator_factory.PlanSelectionCoordinatorFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory responsible for creating PlanSelectionCoordinator instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Instantiates a PlanSelectionCoordinator with injected collaborators.
get_version - Returns factory version string.

Instantiates a PlanSelectionCoordinator with injected collaborators.

Parameters:

  • store – Injected IWaypointStore instance.

  • selection – Injected IPlanSelectionManager instance.

  • dispatcher – Injected IPlanObserverDispatcher instance.

Returns:

Fully initialized PlanSelectionCoordinator instance.
